title: Scarab pool
description: A block producer: forging, KES and the certificate, the rotation driver, sync and peers.

panels.title: Pool alerts firing
panels.description: Alerts of prometheus/rules/pool.yml that are firing now.

panels.title: Node up
panels.description: 1 when the node's /metrics answers the scrape.

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: Restoring, Replaying or Following; a producer forges only while Following.

panels.title: Stalled
panels.description: 1 while the node has not extended its chain for --stall-minutes with a peer ahead.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the process started; a drop to near zero is a restart.

panels.title: Blocks adopted (range)
panels.description: Forged blocks that became the tip of our chain.

panels.title: Blocks lost (range)
panels.description: Forged blocks that did not stay on our chain (a lost slot battle, or replaced).

panels.title: Forge failures (range)
panels.description: Slots the pool led but could not forge in (`forgeFailed`).

panels.title: Expected per epoch
panels.description: The expected blocks per epoch for the pool's stake share (the `expected` box above).

panels.title: Blocks per epoch against the expectation
panels.description: A sliding window of one epoch (the `epoch` box: 5d on Preprod and Mainnet, 1d on Preview). The pool should hover around the expected line; a single epoch varies a lot (Poisson).

panels.title: Leader slots checked and won (per hour)
panels.description: Slots the forger checked for leadership against the slots the pool led; checked should be about one per second of a Following node.

panels.title: Slots that could not be forged or were skipped
KES periods remaining
panels.description: Alerts: warning below 10, critical below 3.

panels.title: Certificate counter
panels.description: The issue counter of the certificate in use; it rises by one with each rotation.

panels.title: KES persist failures (range)
panels.description: Evolved keys that could not be written back to the key file.

panels.title: KES periods: remaining, current and expiry
panels.description: Remaining climbs back each time the rotation driver installs a new certificate.

panels.title: Certificate counter and reloads by outcome
Last success
panels.description: Time since a run ended with exit status 0. Alert: critical beyond 3 hours.

panels.title: Last exit status
panels.description: 0 ok, 1 reload refused, 2 not confirmed, 3 node unreachable, 4 setup wrong.

panels.title: Last rotation
panels.description: Time since the node confirmed credentials the driver installed.

panels.title: Driver: periods remaining when it last looked
Slot lag behind the peers' tip
panels.description: Slots between the highest tip a peer announced and ours. Alert: above 120 for 10 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Our tip and the peers' tip (slot)

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Restarts (process start time)
panels.description: A step is a restart (seconds since 1970).
